sinks._comment_single_column_mode: target_column/encoding below only apply when 'columns' is absent/empty (single whole-record column mode).
sinks._comment_multi_column_mode: when 'columns' is non-empty, the sink switches to multi-column/superset-schema mode: the incoming record is expected to be a superset of this schema. 'source' is the field name looked up in the record, 'target_column' is the ClickHouse column it's written to (defaults to 'source' when omitted - i.e. no aliasing). 'type' is one of string|int64|bool. 'encoding' (text|json, default json) only applies to 'string' columns and controls how a non-string source value is coerced to text.
